source.name: Official online shop of HC Salavat Yulaev: product page "Свитер хоккейный СЮ зелен. арт. SLV280010" (green home replica jersey)
source.quote: Данный свитер является официальным и сертифицированным продуктом
source.note: The page's product photos of the green home replica jersey show the FONBET wordmark across the chest, below the club crest. Fonbet is the KHL championship's title partner (see deal khl-fonbet), so this is league-wide jersey branding, like the BAL's Visit Rwanda placement.

source.name: Sport-Express: «Салават Юлаев» четыре месяца находится без финансирования
source.quote: «Салават Юлаев» с января не может получить финансирование на 2026 год в размере 1,5 миллиарда рублей от своего главного спонсора «Роснефти»
source.note: Names Rosneft as the club's main sponsor (its financier). No shirt placement for Rosneft is documented; recorded as a club partner, as the CSKA Moscow hockey kit record does.

summary: 2026-27 home kit. FONBET wordmark on the chest and both sleeves (KHL title-partner branding) per the club's official shop; Rosneft is the club's main sponsor per Sport-Express, with no shirt placement documented. Front/back/sleeves checked against the official replica; shorts and sock placements not checked. Fonbet and rosneft not yet rated.
